projects.title: Conditional density modeling
projects.text: Several crystal-field parameter sets can explain the same magnetic susceptibility curve. I use residual MLPs with conditional Gaussian mixture models (cGMMs) to learn a distribution over possible solutions instead of one answer. I check candidates with susceptibility simulations, then test predictions under noise, scale changes, and background offsets and on experimental measurements.

projects.title: Robust inverse prediction
projects.text: I infer interaction parameters from complex scattering maps using MLP and ResNet conditional Gaussian mixtures. For powder-averaged neutron scattering, Sunny forward simulations check predictions, with classical fits as references. I test noise, intensity scaling, and background offsets in simulated maps to study robustness for future experimental transfer.

projects.title: Neural models and Monte Carlo
projects.text: I implement neural-network backflow wavefunctions in JAX and optimize them with variational Monte Carlo (VMC) for lattice Hubbard models. My work includes GPU/multi-GPU sampling, local-energy calculations, and gradient synchronization. I profile runtime and check numerical correctness against reference computations.
